heroSummary: Poway USD's regular 180-day calendar runs August 13 through June 3 and includes a Mid-Winter District Recess in February. Abraxas High School follows a separate July 15–June 23 calendar.

calendarNotes: Poway USD starts the regular 2026-2027 school year on August 13, 2026 and ends on June 3, 2027. The student calendar lists 180 student days, Thanksgiving District Recess from November 23-27, Winter District Recess from December 21-January 1, Mid-Winter District Recess from February 15-19, and Spring District Recess from April 12-16. Poway USD also publishes a separate Abraxas High School calendar that starts on July 15, 2026 and ends on June 23, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Poway USD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The regular Poway USD student calendar starts on Thursday, August 13, 2026. Abraxas High School follows a separate calendar that starts on July 15, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Poway USD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring District Recess runs Monday, April 12 through Friday, April 16, 2027 on the regular student calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Poway USD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The regular calendar last day of school is Thursday, June 3, 2027. The Abraxas High School calendar lists June 23, 2027 as its last day.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the Poway USD 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Poway USD 2026-2027 regular student calendar lists 180 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Poway USD Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter District Recess runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Poway USD publish an Abraxas High School calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Poway USD publishes a separate 2026-2027 Student Calendar Abraxas, revised 03/12/26.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Poway USD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Poway USD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

Emergency closures and same-day schedule changes are not controlled by the annual student calendar. Families should check official Poway USD announcements, campus messages, and local emergency updates for tomorrow's school status.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Poway USD winter break start?
calendarFaqs.a: Poway USD Winter District Recess starts Monday, December 21, 2026 on the regular 2026-2027 student calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Poway USD have year-round schools?
calendarFaqs.a: The regular Poway USD calendar is a traditional student calendar. Poway USD also publishes a separate Abraxas High School student calendar, so families at Abraxas should use that official PDF for final date planning.

customSections.label: Poway USD Calendar Overview 2026-2027
customSections.content:
The Poway USD 2026-2027 regular student calendar provides districtwide student dates for school-year planning. Families can use it to track the first day of school, student holidays, non-student days, professional growth days for staff, Thanksgiving District Recess, Winter District Recess, Mid-Winter District Recess, Spring District Recess, and the last day of school.

This page summarizes the regular student calendar and links to the separate Abraxas High School calendar for students who follow that alternate schedule.

customSections.label: Poway USD Abraxas Calendar 2026-2027
customSections.content: Poway USD publishes a separate Abraxas High School student calendar. The Abraxas calendar lists July 15, 2026 as the first day of school, September 17-October 6 as Fall Break, December 18-January 8 as District Recess, March 24-April 16 as District Recess, and June 23, 2027 as the last day of school. Families at Abraxas should use the Abraxas PDF for final date planning.

customSections.label: How We Verify Poway USD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Poway USD calendars page, the regular student calendar PDF, and published alternate-calendar PDFs such as the Abraxas High School calendar. Key dates such as first day, last day, district recesses, holidays, non-student days, professional growth days for staff, and alternate-calendar dates are compared against the official PDFs before being converted into the calendar file used on this page.

The official Poway USD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, testing windows, emergency closures, and same-day announcements.
